gap: No result ChatGPT got states that TESSAN's own store has cut the WTA09 to $27.99 (list $49.99) as of 2026-11-13. That makes the two-AC-outlet WTA09 $15 cheaper than the WTA07 ($42.99), with the same 65 W USB-C 3 port. Epicka's two 65–70 W models in its own store, the Pulse Duo 65W and the TA-105 Pro 70W, both cost $49.99, right at the cap.
standout_why: I compared against Kit Authority (cited in 3 of 5 chats), TrekSavvy, MobilePlusTech and our own 2026-11-03 page. Kit Authority prices only the WTA07 ($42.99 sale / $49.99 list). It does not cover the WTA09, Pulse Duo 65W or TA-105 Pro. TrekSavvy and MobilePlusTech give no dollar prices at all. Our page has the WTA09 at $48.99, which is now stale. One ChatGPT answer (2026-11-08) did show the WTA09 at $27.99 on a TESSAN card, but none of the result pages it got states that price. None of the pages prices the whole field at the maker stores on one date. WIRED could not be fetched, so I could not compare against it.
decides: This settles the pick in favour of the TESSAN WTA09 at $27.99. It matches the WTA07's 65 W on USB-C 3 and adds a second AC outlet, at $15 less, for 1.14 oz more (7.18 oz vs 6.04 oz). The WTA07 becomes the lighter alternative. Epicka's maker-store 65–70 W options (Pulse Duo 65W, TA-105 Pro 70W) cost $49.99, about $22 more for at most 5 W more. The Epicka Air's $16.00 store price is a product-level figure that may belong to a lower-watt variant, so do not quote it as the 65W price.
